description: The two pulse voices and the stepped saw of the Konami VRC6 cartridge chip

params.text: Sets the pitch of that voice, two and a half octaves either side of C4
Attenuates the voltage at that voice's MOD jack before it is added to the pitch, and inverts it below zero
Picks the duty cycle of that pulse, 0 to 7, from a sixteenth up to a full square
Sets the level of that pulse, 0 to 15
Sets the level of the saw, 0 to 63

inputs.text: Raises the pitch of that voice by a volt per octave; unpatched it reads the VOCT jack of the voice before it, and the first pulse reads 0V
Modulates the pitch of that voice, a full octave per 10V with the MOD knob wide open; unpatched it reads the MOD jack of the voice before it, and the first pulse reads 5V
Moves the duty cycle of that pulse, one step per volt; unpatched it reads the PW jack of the first pulse, which itself reads 0V
Scales that voice's AMP knob by the voltage here, 10V leaving the knob untouched and 0V silencing it; unpatched it reads the AMP jack of the voice before it, and the first pulse reads 10V
Restarts the saw from the beginning of its cycle on each rise past 0.02V

outputs.text: Carries that voice's audio, hard clipped at 5V, with the audio of any earlier voice whose own output is unpatched added in

notes: the three outputs are chained: a voice whose output is left unpatched is summed into the next output along, so patching only SAW gives a mix of all three
the frequency knobs move the pitch by two and a half octaves either way, but their read-out in hertz is scaled in semitones, so the number shown while turning one is wrong
